decisions: Measure both revisions with existing calibrate:phonemes --count 10; proposals are diagnostic only, not applied.

Attribute z changes through generateSyllables, repairClusterShape, morphology assembly and final output. Count onsets and codas by root word edge, plus rejection and repair events. Keep bounded full WordTrace witnesses.
Use CMU positional reference only if an identifiable raw source is already available; do not infer positional excess from aggregate CMU shares.
A weight correction requires consistent multi-stream excess in a demonstrated source context, not merely a red gate; no search over weights to hit the ceiling.

If a specific correction is justified, freeze it before using reserved confirmation streams; run full calibration/check/build/diagnostics/performance/frozen quality comparison. Otherwise retain blocker and report the evidence.
